# Flooring Hub
> Raleigh / Triangle flooring contractor. Hardwood, LVP, laminate, and carpet installation by Tom Smith. Free in-home estimates.

## Summary & Identity
- Website: https://www.flooringhubnc.com
- Vertical: Local flooring contractor (not a marketplace)
- Owner: Tom Smith
- Established: 1999 (25+ years)
- Service area: Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Cary, Apex, and the greater Triangle

## AI Agent & Machine Interface

- Full Documentation: https://www.flooringhubnc.com/llms-full.txt

## Interactive Tools & Capabilities (WebMCP)
- `get_service_info`: Return contact details, service area, hours, and services. Does not include pricing.
- `request_estimate`: Explain how to request a free in-home estimate. Does not calculate prices.
